verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho nandiyaṁ sakkaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, the Buddha said to Nandiya the Sakyan:

verses.pali: “catūhi kho, nandiya, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
verses.english: “Nandiya, a noble disciple who has four things is a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.

verses.pali: Idha, nandiya, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti—
verses.english: It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha …

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti.
ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: And they have the ethical conduct loved by the noble ones … leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, nandiya, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
verses.english: A noble disciple who has these four things is a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.”
